result.summary: Found 2 minor issues: a typo in the search placeholder and awkward clipping at the right edge of horizontal carousels.

issues.description: The search placeholder says “Restarants, dishes, groceries”; “Restaurants” is misspelled.
issues.suggestion: Change the placeholder to “Restaurants, dishes, groceries.”

issues.description: The category row and “Fastest near you” cards are abruptly cut off at the right viewport edge, including a nearly empty partial category pill and truncated restaurant content.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right-side padding and tune carousel item widths or scroll affordances so partial items look intentional rather than clipped.
